entries.Original:
Select the items to be purchased automatically during Grand Company Expert Delivery operations.
Purchase Logic:
- The system will attempt to purchase the first available item from the list.
- Purchases will continue until the quantity of that item in your inventory reaches the specified target amount.
If no listed items are available for purchase, or they cannot fit into your inventory:
- The system will purchase Ventures instead.
- Venture purchases will continue until your Venture count reaches 65,000.
Once the Venture cap is reached and no other purchases are possible:
- Any excess Grand Company Seals will be discarded.
entries.Translated:
选择在大国防联军筹备稀有品时自动购买的物品。
购买逻辑：
- 系统会尝试购买列表中第一个可购买的物品。
- 会持续购买，直到该物品在背包中的数量达到设定目标。
如果列表中的物品都无法购买，或背包放不下：
- 系统将改为购买探险币。
- 会持续购买探险币，直到探险币数量达到 65,000。
当探险币达到上限且无法再购买其他物品时：
- 多余的大国防联军军票将被丢弃。

entries.Original: Select this option to fill in your plan with all purchaseable weapons and gear items. By doing so, weapons and items will be purchased and handed right back to the Grand Company, maximizing amount of generated Free Company points. All these items will be placed at the end of the list and only purchased if nothing else is available.

entries.Original: Deletes item from the list if there are multiple copies of it or sets it's amount to 0 if there is only one copy
entries.Translated: 如果列表中有多个该物品则删除此物品；如果只有一个，则将其数量设为 0

entries.Original: Default exchange plan can not be renamed
entries.Translated: 默认兑换方案无法重命名

entries.Original: This amount of seals will be kept after purchase list is executed. However, this value will be capped to be no more than 20000 seals less than maximum possible, according to character's rank.
entries.Translated: 执行购买列表后将保留这么多军票。但根据角色军衔，此值最多只能比可持有上限少 20000 军票。

entries.Original: If selected, after final exchange items will be purchased, otherwise - purchase will not be made until seals are capped again.
entries.Translated: 若选中，最终兑换后会购买物品；否则在军票再次达到上限前不会购买。

entries.Original: Here you can assign preconfigured exchange lists to your registered characters, as well as select delivery mode.
entries.Translated: 可在此为已登记角色分配预设交换列表，并选择交付模式。

entries.Original: character(s) are excluded from buff item usage.
entries.Translated: 个角色已排除增益道具使用。

entries.Original: Navigate to "Functions, Exclusions, Order" section to exclude a character.
entries.Translated: 前往“功能、排除、顺序”部分以排除角色。

entries.Original: character(s) are excluded from buff item purchase.
entries.Translated: 个角色已排除增益道具购买。

entries.Original:
Night mode:
- Wait on login screen option is forcefully enabled
- Built-in FPS limiter restrictions forcefully applied
- While unfocused and awaiting, game is limited to 0.2 FPS
- It may look like game hung up, but let it up to 5 seconds to wake up after you reactivate game window.
- By default, only Deployables are enabled in Night mode
- After disabling Night mode, Bailout manager will activate to relog you back to the game.
entries.Translated:
夜间模式：
- 强制启用“在登录界面等待”选项
- 强制应用内置 FPS 限制器限制
- 未聚焦且等待时，游戏开始将限制为 0.2 FPS
- 看起来可能像游戏开始卡住了，但重新激活游戏开始窗口后最多等待 5 秒即可恢复
- 默认情况下，夜间模式仅启用部署项
- 关闭夜间模式后，救生管理器将启动并让你重新登录回游戏开始。
夜间模式下处理部署项

entries.Original: Make shutdown command activate night mode instead of shutting down the game
entries.Translated: 使 shutdown 命令启动夜间模式，而不是关闭游戏开始

entries.Original: Auto-activate temporary night mode when workstation is locked
entries.Translated: 工作站锁定时自动启动临时夜间模式

entries.Original: Display overlay notification if one of retainers has completed a venture
entries.Translated: 若有雇员完成雇员探险，则显示覆盖通知

entries.Original: Do not display overlay in duty or combat
entries.Translated: 任务中或战斗中不显示覆盖层

entries.Original: Ignore other characters that have not been enabled in MultiMode
entries.Translated: 忽略未在多开模式中启用的其他角色
在游戏聊天中显示通知

entries.Original: If game is inactive: (requires NotificationMaster to be installed and enabled)
entries.Translated: 若游戏未激活：（需已安装并启用 NotificationMaster）

entries.Original: Send desktop notification on retainers available
entries.Translated: 雇员可用时发送桌面通知

entries.Original: Do not notify if AutoRetainer is enabled or MultiMode is running
entries.Translated: 若已启用 AutoRetainer 或多开模式运行中则不通知
从 AutoRetainer 删除列表中的角色

entries.Original: Prune deleted characters in a single click.
entries.Translated: 一键清理已删除的角色。

entries.Original: To continue, you need to install JustBackup plugin.
entries.Translated: 要继续，需安装 JustBackup 插件。

entries.Original:
1. Create a backup by typing /justbackup, ensure it has succeeded and saved into a secure location.
2. Open your character list on FFXIV Lodestone.
entries.Translated:
1. 输入 /justbackup 创建备份，确认已成功并保存到安全位置。
2. 打开 FFXIV Lodestone 的角色列表。

entries.Original: 3. Make sure you are logged with the correct account and copy entire page's content by pressing CTRL+A then CTRL+C
entries.Translated: 3. 确认已登录正确账号，并按 CTRL+A 后再按 CTRL+C 复制整个页面内容

entries.Original: 4. Once finished, click the following button:
Stay in retainer menu if there are retainers to finish ventures within 5 minutes or less
entries.Translated: 若有雇员的探险将在 5 分钟内结束，则停留在雇员菜单中

entries.Original: Auto-disable plugin when closing retainer list
entries.Translated: 关闭雇员列表时自动禁用插件

entries.Original: Do not show plugin status icons

entries.Translated: 显示多模式类型选择器
在工房中显示部署物复选框

entries.Original: Timeout before AutoRetainer will attempt to unstuck, seconds
entries.Translated: AutoRetainer 尝试脱困前的超时，秒

entries.Translated: 在插件 UI 栏显示多模式复选框

entries.Original: Do not error check venture planner
entries.Translated: 不检查探险筹划器错误

entries.Original: Use server time instead of PC time
entries.Translated: 使用服务器时间而非电脑时间

entries.Original: Cutscene skip is detectable server-side and increases chance of ban
entries.Translated: 跳过过场动画可被服务器检测到，并会增加封禁风险

选择军票兑换横向标签

尝试获取当前雇员名称
按名称获取潜水艇索引

entries.Original: The plugin will automatically disable itself at < 2 Ventures or inventory slots available.
entries.Translated: 当探险币或物品栏空位少于 2 时，插件将自动禁用。

entries.Original: Detect and use the closest Summoning Bell within valid distance of the player.
entries.Translated: 检测并使用玩家有效距离内最近的传唤铃。

entries.Original: RetainerSense is enforced to be active during MultiMode operation.
entries.Translated: 多模式运行期间将强制启用 RetainerSense。

entries.Original: Ignore GC rank check for MM delivery
entries.Translated: 忽略 MM 交付的军衔检查

entries.Original: Plugin operation is suppressed by other plugin.
entries.Translated: 插件运行被其他插件阻止。

entries.Original: This character is located on a data center which you have temporarily disabled. Navigate to configuration to remove it.
entries.Translated: 该角色位于你已临时禁用的数据中心。前往配置将其移除。

entries.Original: When operating in multi mode, if there are no other characters with imminent ventures to collect, it will relog back to your preferred character.
entries.Translated: 在多模式下，如果没有其他角色有即将可领取的雇员探险任务奖励，将会重新登录回你的首选角色。

entries.Original: Excluding this character will immediately reset it's settings, remove it from this list and exclude all retainers from being processed. You can still run manual tasks on it's retainers. You can cancel this action in settings.
entries.Translated: 排除此角色将立即重置其设置、将其从此列表中移除，并排除其所有雇员不被处理。你仍可对其雇员执行手动任务。你可以在设置中取消此操作。

entries.Original: Character's saved data will be removed without excluding it. Character data will be regenerated once you log back into this character.
entries.Translated: 将移除此角色的已保存数据，但不会排除该角色。重新登录此角色后将重新生成角色数据。

entries.Original: Free company data, airships and submersibles will be removed from this character. Data will be regenerated once available.
entries.Translated: 将从该角色移除部队数据、飞空艇和潜水艇。数据可用后将重新生成。

entries.Original: This tab checks your configuration for common issues that you can resolve yourself before contacting support.
entries.Translated: 此标签页会检查你的配置中常见的问题，你可以在联系支持前自行解决。

entries.Original: Can not troubleshoot when not logged in.
Inn cutscene skip module is set to
entries.Translated: 旅馆过场跳过模块当前设为

entries.Original: . Inn cutscene will be skipped by AutoRetainer.
entries.Translated: 。旅馆过场将由 AutoRetainer 跳过。

entries.Original: No data available for current character. Access retainer bell, deployables panel or logout to create data.
entries.Translated: 当前角色无可用数据。访问雇员铃、部署面板或退出登录以创建数据。

entries.Original: Ignore GC rank check is enabled. Disable it for normal plugin operation. (/ays set IgnoreGCRankCheck false)
entries.Translated: 已启用忽略军衔检查。请将其禁用以保证插件正常运行。(/ays set IgnoreGCRankCheck false)

entries.Original: Local publisher client detected. AutoRetainer was not tested to work with local publisher's FFXIV clients. Some or all functions may not work. Additionally, keep in mind that ottercorp's Chinese Dalamud fork collects telemetry about your pc, characters, used plugins and Dalamud configuration without your consent and without a possibility to opt-out.
entries.Translated: 检测到本地代理客户端。AutoRetainer 未测试是否可在本地代理的 FFXIV 客户端上正常工作。部分或全部功能可能无法使用。另外请注意，ottercorp 的中国版 Dalamud 分支会在未经你同意且无法选择退出的情况下收集你电脑、角色、已用插件和 Dalamud 配置的遥测数据。
已启用 DontLogout 调试选项

entries.Original: Multi Mode expert delivery free inventory slot trigger value is set to
entries.Translated: 多模式下，筹备稀有品的背包空位触发值设为

entries.Original: while submersible module is enabled. It is recommended to set it to at least 50 to avoid inventory overflow issues.
entries.Translated: ，且已启用潜水艇模块。建议至少设为 50，以避免背包溢出问题。

entries.Original: Some of your multi-mode enabled characters have
entries.Translated: 你的一些已启用多模式的角色启用了

entries.Original: retainers enabled, and Multi Mode expert delivery free inventory slot trigger value is set to
entries.Translated: 雇员，且多模式下，筹备稀有品的背包空位触发值设为

entries.Original: . It is strongly recommended that you set it to at least
has duplicate submersible names. Submersible names must be unique.
entries.Translated: 的潜水艇名称重复。潜水艇名称必须唯一。

entries.Original: "Teleportation is enabled but Lifestream plugin is not installed/loaded. AutoRetainer can not function in this configuration. Either disable teleportation or install Lifestream plugin.
entries.Translated: 已启用传送，但未安装/加载 Lifestream 插件。AutoRetainer 无法在此配置下运行。请禁用传送或安装 Lifestream 插件。

entries.Original: is set as enforced and will override any submarine settings if there is anything to unlock.
entries.Translated: 已设为强制，若有可解锁内容，将覆盖所有潜水艇设置。

entries.Original: is set to deploy on single point in Deep sea site, and it will ignore unlock behavior that is manually set.
entries.Translated: 已设为在深海点单点部署，并会忽略手动设置的解锁行为。

entries.Original: Non-release Dalamud branch detected. This may cause issues. If possible, please open branch switcher by typing /xlbranch, change to "release" and restart your game.
entries.Translated: 检测到非正式版 Dalamud 分支。这可能导致问题。如有可能，请输入 /xlbranch 打开分支切换器，切换到“release”并重启游戏。

entries.Original: You are visiting another world. You must return to your home world before AutoRetainer can continue working on this character.
entries.Translated: 你正在访问其他世界。必须先返回原始世界，AutoRetainer 才能继续处理该角色。

entries.Original: Your current character is excluded from AutoRetainer completely, prevenging it from being processed in any way. Go to settings - exclusions to change it.
entries.Translated: 当前角色已被 AutoRetainer 完全排除，无法以任何方式处理。前往 设置 - 排除 进行修改。

entries.Original: Your current character is excluded from retainer list. Go to settings - exclusions to change it.
entries.Translated: 当前角色已从雇员列表中排除。前往 设置 - 排除 进行修改。

entries.Original: Your current character is excluded from deployable list. Go to settings - exclusions to change it.
entries.Translated: 当前角色已从部署列表中排除。前往 设置 - 排除 进行修改。

entries.Original: For some of your characters, teleportation options are customized. Hover to see list.
entries.Translated: 你的部分角色自定义了传送选项。悬停查看列表。

entries.Original: Teleporting or entering house/apartment is disabled when character is next to retainer bell. Pay attention to house demolition timer.
entries.Translated: 当角色位于雇员铃旁时，将禁用传送或进入房屋/公寓。请注意房屋拆除计时器。

entries.Original: Simple Teleport option is enabled. It's less reliable than registering your houses with Lifestream. If you are experiencing issues with teleportation, consider disabling this option and registering your property with Lifestream.
entries.Translated: 已启用简易传送。其可靠性低于在 Lifestream 中登记房屋。如果你遇到传送问题，建议禁用此选项，并在 Lifestream 中登记你的房产。

entries.Original: Entrust manager is globally disabled, while some retainers have their entrust plans assigned. Entrust plans will only be processed manually.
entries.Translated: 全局已禁用委托管理，但部分雇员已分配委托计划。委托计划只会手动处理。

entries.Original: Extra logging option active. It will spam your log. Only use it when collecting debug information.
entries.Translated: 额外日志已启用。会刷屏日志。仅在收集调试信息时使用。

entries.Original: Time Desynchronization Compensation is set too high (>-5). This may cause issues.
entries.Translated: 时间不同步补偿设置过高（>-5）。这可能导致问题。

entries.Original: Your target frame rate when idling is set too low (<10). This may cause issues.
entries.Translated: 空闲时目标帧率设置过低（<10）。这可能导致问题。

entries.Original: Your target frame rate when operating is set too low (<20). This may cause issues.
entries.Translated: 操作时目标帧率设置过低（<20）。这可能导致问题。

entries.Original: Allow selling items from Armory Chest is enabled. Make sure to add your savage gear and ultimate weapons to protection list.
entries.Translated: 已启用允许出售兵装库中的物品。请确保将零式装备和绝本武器加入护卫列表。

entries.Original: Some of your characters are not enabled for Retainer Multi Mode even though they have retainers. Hover to see list.
entries.Translated: 你的部分角色虽有雇员，但未启用雇员多模式。悬停查看列表。

entries.Original: Some of your characters have not all retainers enabled for processing. Hover to see list.
entries.Translated: 你的部分角色并未为全部雇员启用处理。悬停查看列表。

entries.Original: Some of your characters are not enabled for Deployables Multi Mode even though they have deployables registered. Hover to see list.
entries.Translated: 你的部分角色虽已登记无人岛开拓工房委托，但未启用开拓工房多模式。悬停查看列表。

entries.Original: Some of your characters have not all deployables enabled for processing. Hover to see list.
entries.Translated: 你的部分角色并未为全部开拓工房委托启用处理。悬停查看列表。

entries.Original: Your MultiMode type is set to
entries.Translated: 你的多模式类型设置为

entries.Original: . This will limit functions that AutoRetainer will perform.
entries.Translated: 。这会限制 AutoRetainer 执行的功能。

entries.Original: Some characters have "Wait For All Pending Deployables" option enabled. This means that for these characters AutoRetainer will wait for all deployables to return before processing them. Hover to see complete list of characters with enabled option.
entries.Translated: 部分角色启用了“等待全部待处理开拓工房委托”选项。这意味着对这些角色，AutoRetainer 会等待全部开拓工房委托返回后再处理。悬停查看启用此选项的完整角色列表。

entries.Original: Global option "Wait For Venture Completion" is enabled. This means that for all characters AutoRetainer will wait for all deployables to return before processing them, even for these whose per-character option is disabled.
entries.Translated: 全局选项“等待雇员探险完成”已启用。这意味着对所有角色，AutoRetainer 都会等待全部开拓工房委托返回后再处理，即使这些角色的单独选项已禁用。

entries.Original: Option "Wait even when already logged in" is enabled for deployables. This means that AutoRetainer will wait for all deployables on a character to be completed before processing them even when you are logged in.
entries.Translated: 开拓工房委托已启用“即使已登录也等待”选项。这意味着即使你已登录，AutoRetainer 也会等待角色上的全部开拓工房委托完成后再处理。

entries.Original: Option "Retainer venture processing cutoff" is set to abnormally high value. You may experience significant delays with resending retainers when deployables are soon to be available.
entries.Translated: “雇员探险处理截止时间”选项设置得异常高。当开拓工房委托即将可用时，你在重新派遣雇员时可能会遇到明显延迟。

entries.Original: Option "Retainer venture processing cutoff" is enabled. You may experience delays with resending retainers when deployables are soon to be available.
entries.Translated: “雇员探险处理截止时间”选项已启用。当开拓工房委托即将可用时，你在重新派遣雇员时可能会遇到延迟。

entries.Original: Option "Wait For Venture Completion" is enabled. This means that AutoRetainer will wait for all ventures from all retainers on a character to be completed before logging in to process them.
entries.Translated: “等待雇员探险完成”选项已启用。这意味着 AutoRetainer 会等待角色上全部雇员的所有探险完成后，再登录进行处理。

entries.Original: Option "Wait even when already logged in" is enabled for retainers. This means that AutoRetainer will wait for all ventures from all retainers on a character to be completed before processing them even when you are logged in.
entries.Translated: 雇员已启用“即使已登录也等待”选项。这意味着即使你已登录，AutoRetainer 也会等待角色上全部雇员的所有探险完成后再处理。

entries.Original: Some of your retainers have manual entrust plans set. These plans won't be processed automatically after resending retainer for venture, but only manually upon clicking button in overlay. Hover to see the list.
entries.Translated: 你的部分雇员设置了手动委托计划。这些计划不会在为雇员重新派遣探险后自动处理，而只会在点击悬浮窗中的按钮时手动处理。悬停查看列表。

entries.Original: Some of your retainers' entrust plans were deleted before. Retainers with deleted entrust plans will not entrust anything. Hover to see list.
entries.Translated: 你的一些雇员委托计划此前已被删除。已删除委托计划的雇员将不会委托任何物品。悬停查看列表。

entries.Original: You have "Do not warn about second game instance running from same directory" option enabled, which will skip AutoRetainer's loading on 2nd instance of the game running with the same Dalamud directory automatically.
entries.Translated: 你已启用“不要警告同目录下运行第二个游戏开始实例”选项，这将自动跳过 AutoRetainer 在使用相同 Dalamud 目录运行的第 2 个游戏开始实例中的加载。

entries.Original: Simple Tweaks plugin detected. Any tweaks related to retainers or submarines may affect AutoRetainer functions negatively. Please ensure that tweaks are configured in a way to not interfere with AutoRetainer functions.
entries.Translated: 检测到 Simple Tweaks 插件。任何与雇员或潜水艇相关的调整都可能对 AutoRetainer 功能产生负面影响。请确保这些调整的配置不会干扰 AutoRetainer 功能。

entries.Original: Pandora's Box plugin detected. Automatic use of actions while AutoRetainer is enabled may affect AutoRetainer functions negatively. Please ensure that Pandora's Box is configured in a way to not automatically use actions while AutoRetainer is active.
entries.Translated: 检测到 潘多拉魔盒 插件。启用 AutoRetainer 时自动使用技能可能对 AutoRetainer 功能产生负面影响。请确保 潘多拉魔盒 的配置不会在 AutoRetainer 运行时自动使用技能。

entries.Original: Automaton plugin detected. Automatic use of actions and automatic numeric inputs while AutoRetainer is enabled may affect AutoRetainer functions negatively. Please ensure that Automaton is configured in a way to not use automatically actions while AutoRetainer is active.
entries.Translated: 检测到 Automaton 插件。启用 AutoRetainer 时自动使用技能和自动数字输入可能对 AutoRetainer 功能产生负面影响。请确保 Automaton 的配置不会在 AutoRetainer 运行时自动使用技能。

entries.Original: RotationSolver plugin detected. Automatic use of actions while AutoRetainer is enabled may affect AutoRetainer functions negatively. Please ensure that RotationSolver is configured in a way to not automatically use actions while AutoRetainer is active.
entries.Translated: 检测到 RotationSolver 插件。启用 AutoRetainer 时自动使用技能可能对 AutoRetainer 功能产生负面影响。请确保 RotationSolver 的配置不会在 AutoRetainer 运行时自动使用技能。

entries.Original: BossMod plugin detected. Automatic use of actions while AutoRetainer is enabled may affect AutoRetainer functions negatively. Please ensure that BossMod is configured in a way to not automatically use actions while AutoRetainer is active.
entries.Translated: 检测到 BossMod 插件。启用 AutoRetainer 时自动使用技能可能对 AutoRetainer 功能产生负面影响。请确保 BossMod 的配置不会在 AutoRetainer 运行时自动使用技能。

entries.Original: Expert settings alter behavior that was intended by developer. Please check that your issue is not related to incorrectly configured expert settings.
entries.Translated: 专家设置会更改开发者预期的行为。请检查你的问题是否与专家设置配置错误有关。

entries.Original: Action on accessing retainer bell if no ventures available
entries.Translated: 无探险可用时访问雇员铃的操作

entries.Original: Action on accessing retainer bell if any ventures available
entries.Translated: 有任意探险可用时访问雇员铃的操作

entries.Original: Task completion behavior after accessing bell
entries.Translated: 访问雇员铃后的任务完成行为

entries.Original: Task completion behavior after manual enabling
entries.Translated: 手动启用后的任务完成行为

entries.Original: Upon activating Multi Mode, attempt to enter nearby house
entries.Translated: 启用多模式时，尝试进入附近房屋

entries.Original: Enable submersibles in multi mode on this character
entries.Translated: 为该角色在多模式中启用潜水艇

Left click - relog to this character
Right click - open quick travel window
entries.Translated:
